dent.label: Dent
dent.definition: Localized inward/outward deformation without defining structural damage.

scratch.label: Scratch
scratch.definition: Linear surface abrasion or finish damage.

scuff.label: Scuff
scuff.definition: Broad superficial abrasion or transfer mark.

chip.label: Chip
chip.definition: Small localized loss/chip in paint, coating, or glass.

broken.label: Broken
broken.definition: Component visibly fractured or no longer physically intact.

bent.label: Bent
bent.definition: Component visibly bent from expected geometry.

deformation.label: Deformation
deformation.definition: Shape differs materially from expected form.

misaligned.label: Misaligned
misaligned.definition: Panel/component gaps or geometry visibly inconsistent.

clearcoat_damage.label: Clearcoat damage
clearcoat_damage.definition: Visible clear-coat failure, peeling, or checking.

fading.label: Fading
fading.definition: Visible color/finish fade compared with surrounding area.

peeling.label: Peeling
peeling.definition: Coating, film, material, or finish visibly peeling.

shattered.label: Shattered
shattered.definition: Glass is extensively fractured into many pieces/fragments.

dry_rot.label: Dry rot
dry_rot.definition: Cracking/aging pattern consistent with degraded rubber.

leak.label: Leak
leak.definition: Visible active fluid escape or clear wet source evidence.

seepage.label: Seepage
seepage.definition: Light wetness/residue consistent with slow seepage.

excessive_wear.label: Excessive wear
excessive_wear.definition: Wear appears beyond normal/acceptable visual range.

heat_damage.label: Heat damage
heat_damage.definition: Visible heat discoloration, melting, charring, or thermal deformation.

previous_repair.label: Previous repair
previous_repair.definition: Visible evidence consistent with prior repair/refinish.

overspray.label: Overspray
overspray.definition: Paint/coating overspray visible on adjacent surfaces.

water_intrusion.label: Water intrusion
water_intrusion.definition: Visible water entry, staining, or trapped moisture evidence.

damaged.label: Damaged
damaged.definition: Visible or documented damage not more specifically classified.

worn.label: Worn
worn.definition: Observable wear is present but not necessarily beyond an allowable limit.

uneven_wear.label: Uneven wear
uneven_wear.definition: Wear is materially non-uniform across the component or contact surface.

abrasion.label: Abrasion
abrasion.definition: Surface material has been worn or rubbed away.

gouge.label: Gouge
gouge.definition: Deep localized material loss or cut-like surface damage.

cut.label: Cut
cut.definition: Material has a visible cut or slice.

disconnected.label: Disconnected
disconnected.definition: A connection that should be joined is visibly or functionally disconnected.

unsecured.label: Unsecured
unsecured.definition: Component is present but not securely retained or fastened.

chafed.label: Chafed
chafed.definition: Surface wear from repeated rubbing/contact is visible.

exposed_conductor.label: Exposed conductor
exposed_conductor.definition: Electrical conductor is visible due to damaged or missing insulation.

connector_damage.label: Connector damage
connector_damage.definition: Electrical connector housing, pins, lock, or seal is visibly damaged.

melted.label: Melted
melted.definition: Material is visibly melted or softened by heat.

burn_damage.label: Burn damage
burn_damage.definition: Charring, scorching, or other visible burn damage is present.

discolored.label: Discolored
discolored.definition: Abnormal or localized discoloration is visible.

contaminated.label: Contaminated
contaminated.definition: Foreign material or fluid contamination is visibly present.

obstructed.label: Obstructed
obstructed.definition: Opening, passage, lens, sensor, or moving area is visibly blocked.

collapsed.label: Collapsed
collapsed.definition: Component is visibly collapsed from its expected shape.

swollen.label: Swollen
swollen.definition: Component is visibly swollen or expanded beyond expected geometry.

glazed.label: Glazed
glazed.definition: Surface has a smooth/glassy appearance consistent with glazing.

scored.label: Scored
scored.definition: Surface has visible scoring lines or grooves from contact/wear.

grooved.label: Grooved
grooved.definition: Pronounced wear grooves are visible in a contact surface.

residue.label: Residue
residue.definition: Residue or staining is visible without enough evidence to call an active leak.

low_level.label: Low level
low_level.definition: Measured or clearly visible level is below the applicable reference range.

overfilled.label: Overfilled
overfilled.definition: Measured or clearly visible level is above the applicable reference range.

low_tread.label: Low tread
low_tread.definition: Tread depth is visually or measurably low.

abnormal_noise.label: Abnormal noise
abnormal_noise.definition: Component/system produces an abnormal sound during an applicable test.

excessive_play.label: Excessive play
excessive_play.definition: Measured or observed free play exceeds expected behavior.

binding.label: Binding
binding.definition: Movement is restricted, sticking, or binding during an applicable test.

inoperative.label: Inoperative
inoperative.definition: Component does not operate during an applicable functional test.

intermittent.label: Intermittent
intermittent.definition: Component or function operates inconsistently during testing.

out_of_spec.label: Out of spec
out_of_spec.definition: Measured value is outside the applicable vehicle/component specification.

unreadable.label: Unreadable
unreadable.definition: Required text, marking, label, display, or identifier cannot be reliably read.

damaged_seal.label: Damaged seal
damaged_seal.definition: Seal, gasket, weatherstrip, or boot is visibly damaged.

warning_indicator_on.label: Warning indicator on
warning_indicator_on.definition: A warning indicator remains illuminated with the engine running.

low_pressure.label: Low pressure
low_pressure.definition: Measured pressure is below the applicable specification.

over_pressure.label: Over pressure
over_pressure.definition: Measured pressure is above the applicable specification.

aged.label: Aged
aged.definition: Component age (date code or install date) exceeds the recommended service life.

exposed_cord.label: Exposed cord
exposed_cord.definition: Tire cords/belts are visible through tread or sidewall.

dim.label: Dim
dim.definition: Lamp operates but output is visibly reduced.

misaimed.label: Misaimed
misaimed.definition: Beam or sensor aim is visibly outside the expected pattern.

streaking.label: Streaking
streaking.definition: Wiper leaves streaks, smears or chatters.

failed_test.label: Failed test
failed_test.definition: Component failed an instrument or functional test (tester, gauge, strip, pressure test, scan).

service_due.label: Service due
service_due.definition: Scheduled service interval (miles/time) is reached or exceeded.

discharged.label: Discharged
discharged.definition: Battery state of charge is low; recharge and retest before condemning.

sagging.label: Sagging
sagging.definition: Component or ride height sits visibly lower than expected.

degraded_fluid.label: Degraded fluid
degraded_fluid.definition: Fluid is dark, burnt, sludgy, milky or otherwise degraded.

poor_performance.label: Poor performance
poor_performance.definition: System operates but below the expected output (e.g. A/C vent temperature, heater output).

points.name: Walkaround, VIN, and tire placard photos
points.note: Walk-around photos document overall condition; body damage found here is recorded on the specific panel class (e.g. door @ left_front).

points.name: Engine cranking
points.note: Cranking check lands on the starter; cranking voltage (if measured) lands on the battery.

points.name: Instrument cluster photos
points.note: Each lit lamp becomes a warning_indicator with its subtype (e.g. check_engine); codes are stored as DTCs.

points.name: Noise, vibration, or pulling noticed
points.note: Symptom point, not a component. Recorded as a vehicle_concern (noise / vibration / pull); when the cause is found it is linked to the component(s), e.g. tire, wheel_hub_bearing, brake_rotor.

points.name: Powertrain performance
points.note: Mostly a symptom check → vehicle_concern; engine running condition lands on engine_assembly.

points.name: Horn and exterior lights
points.note: One shop point becomes ~20 components, so a single burned-out bulb has its own history.

points.name: Engine coolant
points.note: The example note mixes coolant condition and a thermostat code; Wrynch records them on two components.

points.name: Power steering fluid
points.note: N/A automatically on electric power steering.

points.name: Air filter
points.note: Example: broken air box is a finding on the housing; the filter itself is 'unable to assess'.

points.name: Timing belt/chain
points.note: Vehicle configuration decides belt vs chain; the other becomes N/A.

points.name: Fuel system
points.note: The example note is service history ('serviced at 162,292'); Wrynch stores that as a service_event, not a condition.

points.name: Visual brake system condition
points.note: One shop point, up to 20 components. Pads/rotors each get a measured value per corner.

points.name: Suspension components (shocks, struts, control arms, ball joints, etc)
points.note: Upper vs lower ball joint / control arm is stored as subtype (e.g. ball_joint @ left_front, subtype upper).

points.name: Steering components (tie rods, steering gear, etc.)
Fluid leaks noticed
points.note: A sweep point: a leak that is found is recorded on the component that is leaking.

points.name: High-voltage battery
points.note: Visual from a safe distance plus scan-tool state of health. Never open or probe high-voltage parts during an MPI.

points.name: Charge port
points.note: The vehicle setup records where the charge port is; only that position applies.
